backup.before_mls: This backup is from before the switch to MLS: it holds no key this device can use.
backup.malformed: The key backup is not in a valid form.
backup.missing: There is no key backup on this instance.
backup.no_crypto: WebCrypto is not available. It needs a secure connection (HTTPS or localhost).
backup.unknown_format: The key backup is in a form this device does not know.
blocked.history.body: This device has just joined the conversation. Messages are read with a key that another person in the conversation hands back to you when they open it again: until that happens they don't open here, and writing would mean sending something nobody could read.
blocked.history.next: You don't need to do anything: as soon as {{name}} opens this conversation again, the messages open here by themselves and you can write.
blocked.history.placeholder: Wait for {{name}} to open the conversation again
blocked.history.title: This conversation is still opening on this device
blocked.home_down.body: Private messages travel from one home to another, and {{name}}'s is not answering right now — it is switched off, or can't be reached from here. It is not your problem, and it is not a problem with the keys.
blocked.home_down.next: You don't need to do anything here: the instance notices by itself when that home is back, and the conversation picks up from there. If it doesn't come back, {{name}} is the one who needs to switch it on again.
blocked.home_down.title: {{name}}'s home is not answering
blocked.insecure.body: The browser keeps encryption switched off when the address is not protected, and ESTIA does not send private messages without encryption. From this connection you can neither read nor write — and as long as you come in from here, nobody can write to you.
blocked.insecure.next: Open ESTIA from an address that starts with “https://”, or from “localhost” on the machine where the instance runs. The rest of ESTIA works all the same: only private messages stop here.
blocked.insecure.placeholder: Private messages can't be written here
blocked.insecure.title: Private messages don't work on this connection
blocked.no_device.body: A private message is locked with a key that is created on the reader's device, and {{name}} doesn't have one yet. There is nothing to lock it with, and ESTIA never sends a message unencrypted — not even once.
blocked.no_device.next: Let them know another way: they only need to open ESTIA once from an “https://” address or from “localhost”. From then on you can write to them, and they will never have to do it again.
blocked.no_device.title: You can't write to {{name}} yet
blocked.waiting.body: {{name}} started this conversation from their home, and the invitation for this device hasn't arrived yet. Until it does, you can neither read nor write here.
blocked.waiting.next: You don't need to do anything: as soon as {{name}} opens the conversation on their side, the invitation arrives here and you can write.
blocked.waiting.placeholder: Waiting for {{name}} to open the conversation
blocked.waiting.title: The conversation isn't ready here yet
bubble.unavailable.body: The writer's instance is not answering: the message is there, and you can read it again when their home is back on.
bubble.unavailable.title: Content not available
bubble.unreadable.body: This device doesn't have the key to open it. It happens to a device that has just joined the conversation, until someone else opens it again.
bubble.unreadable.title: Can't be opened
chat.empty: No messages. Send the first encrypted message!
chat.opening: Opening the conversation on this device…
chat.unavailable_notice: Some messages are kept by a home that is not answering right now. Who wrote them and when is still here; the content comes back as soon as that home is on again.

composer.opening: One moment: the conversation is opening…

nav.insecure: Private messages don't work from this connection: the browser keeps encryption switched off when the address is not protected. You can't read or write them, and nobody can write to you. Open ESTIA from an “https://” address, or from “localhost” on the instance's machine.
restore.body: These messages were locked with keys this browser doesn't have. If you made a copy, your passphrase opens it and puts the keys back here: from then on the messages can be read again.
restore.done: Key put back on this browser: you are back in your conversations, and the history returns when the other people open them again.
restore.error: This passphrase doesn't open the copy, or there isn't one.
restore.title: Put your keys back on this browser

search.none: Nobody by this name at home or on the network.
